preconditions.description: The number of tiles n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {1, 2} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each tile value a_i must be either 1 or 2.
The length of the list of tile values must equal n.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of the permutation b.
All prefix sums of the permutation b must be prime numbers.

postconditions.expression: len([prefix_sum for prefix_sum in prefix_sums(b) if is_prime(prefix_sum)]) == max_primes
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in the permutation b must be maximized.
